descmd: The changes in this technical correction have been reviewed and commented upon by the public through the HL7 errata process. The [HL7 International Payer/Provider Information Exchange Work Group](http://www.hl7.org/Special/committees/claims) members agreed to and voted on the resolution of the community review comments and edits to this guide. For a detailed list of the changes for this version, see the [Change Notes](http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-cdex/STU2.1.1/changes.html).
